<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"><title>막짱 RPG</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#12331f;--fg:#fff;--ac:#f1c40f;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:system-ui,"Malgun Gothic",sans-serif}
canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#ui{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none}#ui>*{pointer-events:auto}
.full{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;background:linear-gradient(#1e5b34,#12331f);text-align:center}
h1{font-size:54px;margin:0;color:var(--ac);text-shadow:0 4px 0 #6b4423}
.b{background:#2d6a43;color:#fff;border:2px solid #4c9a68;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;margin:2px}
.b.on{background:var(--ac);color:#222;border-color:#fff}.b.go{background:#c0392b;font-size:18px;margin-top:10px}
input{padding:9px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #888;font-size:15px;width:230px}
.bar{width:min(420px,80vw);height:18px;border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:10px;position:relative;margin-top:40px}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--ac);border-radius:6px}
.knight{position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:0;width:30px;height:60px;margin-left:-15px}
.knight s{position:absolute;display:block;background:#b0b7c0;border:2px solid #555}
.knight .h{left:5px;top:0;width:20px;height:16px;border-radius:6px 6px 2px 2px}.knight .t{left:3px;top:18px;width:24px;height:22px}
.knight .l1,.knight .l2{top:40px;width:9px;height:18px;transform-origin:top;animation:w .4s infinite alternate}.knight .l1{left:4px}.knight .l2{left:17px;animation-delay:.2s}
@keyframes w{from{transform:rotate(25deg)}to{transform:rotate(-25deg)}}
.pn{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:min(360px,92vw);overflow:auto;background:#000b;border-radius:12px;padding:12px}
.pn h3{margin:8px 0 4px}.cat{font-size:13px;color:#ccc;margin-top:6px}
.hud{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;background:#000a;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.hp{width:150px;height:10px;background:#600;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}.hp i{display:block;height:100%;background:#e74c3c}
#msg{position:absolute;top:18%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:20px;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #000;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
#cap{position:absolute;bottom:56px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;color:#222;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px;max-width:80vw;display:none}
#hint{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:12px;background:#0008;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap}
#inv{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;width:250px;background:#000c;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;display:none;font-size:14px}
.cut{position:absolute;bottom:12%;width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:26px;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000;pointer-events:none}
#chat{position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:50px;width:min(420px,92vw);background:#000d;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;display:none}#ql{max-height:170px;overflow:auto;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;line-height:1.5}#chat input{width:70%}#hint{white-space:normal;text-align:center;width:max-content;max-width:94vw}
.mp{background:#123}.mp i{background:#3498db}.hp{margin:2px 0}#bossb{position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:none;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #000}#dlg{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:60px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(480px,94vw);background:#000d;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;display:none;line-height:1.7}#tk{position:absolute;bottom:92px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#000a;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:8px}#tk:empty{display:none}#mm{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#0008;border:2px solid #fff}#inv{top:10px;max-height:80vh;overflow:auto}#dlg{width:min(660px,94vw)}.dr{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end}.dr img{height:190px;max-width:150px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px #000)}.dt{flex:1}
</style></head><body><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="ui"></div>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>const IMG={"m": "data:image/png;base64,", "f": "data:image/png;base64,", "shop": "data:image/png;base64,", "inn": "data:image/png;base64,", "smith": "data:image/png;base64,", "herb": "data:image/png;base64,", "farm1": "data:image/png;base64,", "lib": "data:image/png;base64,", "baker": "data:image/png;base64,", "chief": "data:image/png;base64,", "farm2": "data:image/png;base64,", "bard": "data:image/png;base64,"};</script>
<script>
const T=THREE,$=s=>document.querySelector(s),ui=$('#ui'),mem={};
const ls={g:k=>{try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return mem[k]||null}},s:(k,v)=>{mem[k]=v;try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}}};
const R=new T.WebGLRenderer({canvas:$('#c'),antialias:true}),cam=new T.PerspectiveCamera(60,1,.1,700);R.shadowMap.enabled=true;R.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
function rs(){R.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);cam.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;cam.updateProjectionMatrix()}addEventListener('resize',rs);rs();
let sc=new T.Scene(),mode='load',user=null,look={g:'M',hair:0,eye:0,top:0,bottom:0,hat:0,shoe:0,cHair:0,cScarf:0,cShoe:0},names={p:'',c:''},inv={},hm,cm;
const M=c=>new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:c});
function bx(g,w,h,d,c,x=0,y=0,z=0){const m=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),M(c));m.castShadow=m.receiveShadow=true;m.position.set(x,y,z);g.add(m);return m}
const PC=['#e74c3c','#3498db','#2ecc71','#f1c40f','#9b59b6','#ecf0f1'],PN=['빨강','파랑','초록','노랑','보라','흰색'],HC=['#3b2a1a','#111','#c0392b','#e8c15a','#6b4423','#7f8c8d'];
const HM=[[[.56,.16,.56,0,.22,0]],[[.56,.3,.56,0,.25,0]],[[.12,.32,.12,-.17,.33,0],[.12,.4,.12,0,.37,0],[.12,.32,.12,.17,.33,0]],[[.56,.16,.56,0,.22,0],[.56,.4,.1,0,.05,-.26]],[[.28,.3,.28,-.15,.28,0],[.28,.3,.28,.15,.28,0],[.28,.3,.28,0,.32,.1]],[]];
const HF=[[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.6,.4,.6,0,0,-.05]],[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.6,.9,.1,0,-.25,-.28],[.1,.6,.5,-.3,-.1,0],[.1,.6,.5,.3,-.1,0]],[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.14,.6,.14,0,0,-.35]],[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.2,.2,.2,-.38,0,0],[.2,.2,.2,.38,0,0]],[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.25,.25,.25,0,.45,0]],[[.6,.16,.6,0,.22,0],[.7,.7,.12,0,-.2,-.3],[.14,.5,.5,-.35,-.1,0],[.14,.5,.5,.35,-.1,0]]];
const HT=[[],[[.95,.04,.95,0,.27,0,'#e5c07b'],[.5,.2,.5,0,.38,0,'#e5c07b']],[[.58,.14,.58,0,.3,0,'#2980b9'],[.58,.04,.3,0,.26,.35,'#2980b9']],[[.5,.15,.5,0,.33,0,'#f1c40f'],[.1,.15,.1,-.2,.46,0,'#f1c40f'],[.1,.15,.1,0,.46,0,'#f1c40f'],[.1,.15,.1,.2,.46,0,'#f1c40f']],[[.85,.04,.85,0,.27,0,'#7b4a1e'],[.5,.25,.5,0,.4,0,'#7b4a1e']],[[.6,.24,.6,0,.32,0,'#fff']]];
function human(l){const g=new T.Group();bx(g,.5,.5,.5,'#f1c27d',0,1.75,0);
(l.g=='M'?HM:HF)[l.hair].forEach(s=>bx(g,s[0],s[1],s[2],HC[l.hair],s[3],1.75+s[4],s[5]));
const E=[[.07,.07,'#000'],[.11,.11,'#000'],[.1,.04,'#000'],[.1,.05,'#d35400'],[.12,.05,'#222'],[.09,.09,'#2980b9']][l.eye];
[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>bx(g,E[0],E[1],.02,E[2],x,1.78,.26));
HT[l.hat].forEach(s=>bx(g,s[0],s[1],s[2],s[6],s[3],1.75+s[4],s[5]));
bx(g,.6,.7,.3,PC[l.top],0,1.15,0);g.aL=bx(g,.18,.65,.18,PC[l.top],-.4,1.15,0);g.aR=bx(g,.18,.65,.18,PC[l.top],.4,1.15,0);
g.lL=bx(g,.25,.8,.25,PC[l.bottom],-.15,.4,0);g.lR=bx(g,.25,.8,.25,PC[l.bottom],.15,.4,0);
[g.lL,g.lR].forEach(L=>bx(L,.27,.15,.35,PC[l.shoe],0,-.33,.04));[g.aL,g.aR].forEach(A=>bx(A,.19,.17,.19,'#f1c27d',0,-.38,0));bx(g,.64,.1,.34,'#4a3320',0,.82,0);bx(g,.1,.04,.02,'#a0522d',0,1.64,.26);bx(g,.06,.1,.06,'#e0ac69',0,1.74,.27);[-.27,.27].forEach(x=>bx(g,.06,.14,.1,'#f1c27d',x,1.75,0));[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>bx(g,.12,.03,.02,HC[l.hair],x,1.88,.26));bx(g,.3,.1,.32,'#f1c27d',0,1.5,0);g.rotation.order='YXZ';return g}
function capy(l){const g=new T.Group(),b='#a0703c';bx(g,.7,.6,1.1,b,0,.6,0);bx(g,.45,.45,.5,'#b5834a',0,.8,.7);bx(g,.3,.2,.15,'#5a3d1e',0,.74,1);
[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>{bx(g,.07,.07,.04,'#000',x,.9,.96);bx(g,.1,.1,.1,'#7b5228',x*1.6,1.05,.55)});
[[-.25,-.4],[.25,-.4],[-.25,.4],[.25,.4]].forEach(p=>{const L=bx(g,.18,.4,.18,b,p[0],.2,p[1]);bx(L,.2,.1,.2,PC[l.cShoe],0,-.17,.02)});
bx(g,.74,.55,.22,PC[l.cScarf],0,.75,.45);
const h=l.cHair;if(h==1){bx(g,.25,.1,.1,'#e84393',0,1.05,.7)}else if(h==2){bx(g,.16,.16,.1,'#fd79a8',.12,1.08,.65);bx(g,.07,.07,.12,'#f1c40f',.12,1.08,.65)}else if(h==3){bx(g,.2,.05,.3,'#27ae60',0,1.04,.7)}else if(h==4){bx(g,.3,.12,.3,'#f1c40f',0,1.08,.7)}else if(h==5){bx(g,.55,.05,.55,'#2d3436',0,1.03,.7);bx(g,.3,.15,.3,'#2d3436',0,1.12,.7)}return g}
function screen(h,c){ui.innerHTML='<div class="'+(c==null?'full':c)+'">'+h+'</div>'}
/* 로딩 */
function loading(){mode='load';screen('<h2>🦫 막짱 RPG</h2><div class="bar"><i id="lb"></i><div class="knight" id="kn"><s class="h"></s><s class="t"></s><s class="l1"></s><s class="l2"></s></div></div><div>로딩 중…</div>');
let p=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{p+=2+Math.random()*3;if(p>=100){p=100;clearInterval(iv);setTimeout(title,500)}$('#lb').style.width=p+'%';$('#kn').style.left=p+'%'},60)}
function title(){screen('<h1>🦫 막짱 RPG</h1><div>카피바라와 함께하는 섬 생존 모험</div><button class="b go" onclick="loginUI()">▶ 게임 플레이</button>')}
function loginUI(){screen('<h2>로그인</h2><button class="b" onclick="gLogin()">G 구글로 로그인</button><div style="font-size:12px;color:#aaa">※ 데모 버전: 실제 구글 연동은 OAuth 키가 필요해요</div><div>또는</div><input id="id" placeholder="아이디"><input id="pw" type="password" placeholder="비밀번호"><button class="b" onclick="idLogin()">아이디로 로그인 / 가입</button>')}
function gLogin(){user='google_user';choose()}
function idLogin(){const id=$('#id').value.trim(),pw=$('#pw').value;if(!id||!pw)return alert('아이디와 비밀번호를 입력해 주세요');
let us={};try{us=JSON.parse(ls.g('mj_users')||'{}')}catch(e){}
if(us[id]===undefined){us[id]=pw;ls.s('mj_users',JSON.stringify(us))}else if(us[id]!==pw)return alert('비밀번호가 맞지 않아요');user='id_'+id;choose()}
function choose(){screen('<h2>환영합니다!</h2><button class="b go" onclick="creator()">신규 유저입니까?</button><button class="b go" style="background:#2980b9" onclick="cont()">이어서 플레이 하시겠습니까?</button>')}
function cont(){let s=null;try{s=JSON.parse(ls.g('mj_save_'+user))}catch(e){}
if(!s){alert('저장된 플레이 기록이 없어요. 신규 유저로 시작합니다.');return creator()}
look=s.look;names=s.names;inv=s.inv;world();P.x=s.x;P.z=s.z;S.t=s.t;qi=s.qi||0;qp=s.qp||0;if(s.ps)Object.assign(P,s.ps);eq=s.eq||{w:null,a:null};chest=s.chest||{};P.hp=P.mx;P.mp=P.mmx;bossDead=+s.bd||0;for(let i=0;i<(s.vl||0);i++){vl++;addHouse(5+vl);addVill()}(s.bl||[]).forEach(b=>place(b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]));startPlay(true)}
/* 캐릭터 꾸미기 */
const CAT=[['hair','머리',()=>look.g=='M'?['짧은머리','스포츠','뾰족','올백','곱슬','삭발']:['단발','긴머리','포니테일','양갈래','똥머리','웨이브']],['eye','눈',['동그란','큰눈','졸린','웃는','날카로운','반짝']],['top','상의',PN],['bottom','하의',PN],['hat','모자',['없음','밀짚','야구','왕관','모험가','털모자']],['shoe','신발',PN]],
CAP=[['cHair','헤어',['없음','리본','꽃','잎','왕관','모자']],['cScarf','목도리',PN],['cShoe','신발',PN]];
const rows=L=>L.map(c=>{const n=typeof c[2]=='function'?c[2]():c[2];return'<div class="cat">'+c[1]+'</div>'+n.map((t,i)=>'<button class="b '+(look[c[0]]==i?'on':'')+'" onclick="Pk(\''+c[0]+'\','+i+')">'+t+'</button>').join('')}).join('');
function creator(){mode='creator';sc=new T.Scene();sc.background=new T.Color('#9ad1ff');sc.add(new T.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.75));const d=new T.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.8);d.position.set(3,5,4);sc.add(d);
const f=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(4,4,.2,32),M('#58a64a'));f.position.y=-.1;sc.add(f);refresh();panel()}
function refresh(){hm&&sc.remove(hm);cm&&sc.remove(cm);hm=human(look);hm.position.set(-1.2,0,0);cm=capy(look);cm.position.set(1.4,0,0);sc.add(hm,cm)}
function panel(){screen('<h3>🧑 캐릭터 꾸미기</h3>성별 <button class="b '+(look.g=='M'?'on':'')+'" onclick="Pk(\'g\',\'M\')">남자</button><button class="b '+(look.g=='F'?'on':'')+'" onclick="Pk(\'g\',\'F\')">여자</button>'+rows(CAT)+'<h3>🦫 카피바라 AI 꾸미기</h3>'+rows(CAP)+'<br><button class="b go" onclick="intro()">완료 → 모험 시작</button>','pn')}
function Pk(k,v){look[k]=v;if(k=='g')look.hair=0;refresh();panel()}
/* 월드 */
let AC;function sfx(k){try{AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain(),F={hit:[200,.1,'square'],chop:[130,.12,'sawtooth'],pick:[700,.1,'sine'],ok:[900,.3,'triangle'],hurt:[110,.25,'sawtooth'],build:[300,.15,'square'],mine:[400,.08,'square'],jump:[500,.08,'sine']}[k],t=AC.currentTime;o.type=F[2];o.frequency.setValueAtTime(F[0],t);if(k=='ok')o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1400,t+.3);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.12,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+F[1]);o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start();o.stop(t+F[1])}catch(e){}}
const BT={'늑대':{c:'#4a4a52',s:1,hp:8,dmg:2,sp:4.2},'멧돼지':{c:'#7a5233',s:1.2,hp:14,dmg:3,sp:3.8},'곰':{c:'#3b2a1a',s:1.8,hp:28,dmg:4,sp:3}};
function beast(n){const b=BT[n],g=new T.Group(),c=b.c;bx(g,.7,.7,1.4,c,0,.7,0);bx(g,.5,.5,.5,c,0,.95,.85);[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>bx(g,.1,.1,.05,'#f00',x,1.05,1.12));[[-.25,-.5],[.25,-.5],[-.25,.5],[.25,.5]].forEach(p=>bx(g,.15,.4,.15,'#222',p[0],.2,p[1]));g.scale.setScalar(b.s);return g}
function spawnW(){nn++;const k=Math.min(nn,5),L=[];for(let i=0;i<3+k;i++)L.push('늑대');for(let i=0;i<1+(k>>1);i++)L.push('멧돼지');if(k>=2)L.push('곰');L.forEach(n=>{const b=BT[n],a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(40,100),m=beast(n);m.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,Math.sin(a)*r);sc.add(m);wolves.push({m,hp:b.hp,a,n,s:b.s,dmg:b.dmg,sp:b.sp})})}
const Q=[{t:'wood',n:10,x:'목재 10개 모으기'},{t:'pick',n:1,x:'곡괭이 만들기'},{t:'stone',n:5,x:'돌 5개 캐기'},{t:'iron',n:3,x:'철광석 3개 찾기'},{t:'sword',n:1,x:'검 만들기'},{t:'build',n:5,x:'블록 5개 설치하기'},{t:'kill',n:3,x:'맹수 3마리 물리치기'},{t:'lv',n:3,x:'레벨 3번 올리기'},{t:'boss',n:1,x:'던전의 보스 석상 왕 처치하기'},{t:'boss1',n:1,x:'눈의 던전 얼음 거인 처치하기'},{t:'boss2',n:1,x:'화염 던전 화염 드래곤 처치하기'},{t:'city',n:1,x:'대도시 시장 만나기'}];
function qadd(t,n){const q=Q[qi];if(!q||q.t!=t)return;qp+=n;if(qp>=q.n){msg('📜 퀘스트 완료! 목재 +3');sfx('ok');qi++;qp=0;inv.wood=(inv.wood||0)+3;invUI()}}
function qUI(){const e=$('#qs'),q=Q[qi];if(e)e.textContent=q?'📜 '+q.x+' ('+qp+'/'+q.n+')':'📜 모든 퀘스트 완료! 🎉'}
const BN={w:'나무 블록',s:'돌 블록',f:'모닥불'},BC={w:{wood:1},s:{stone:1},f:{wood:2}};
function place(t,x,z,k){const f=t=='f',m=bx(sc,f?.6:1.2,f?.5:1.2,f?.6:1.2,t=='w'?'#b5793a':t=='s'?'#9aa0a8':'#ff7a1a',x,k*1.2+(f?.25:.6),z);blocks.push({t,x,z,k,y:k*1.2+.6,m})}
function build(){const c=BC[bsel];if(!Object.keys(c).every(x=>(inv[x]||0)>=c[x]))return msg('재료 부족: '+BN[bsel]+' = '+Object.keys(c).map(x=>N[x]+c[x]).join(', '));const a=pl.rotation.y,cx=Math.round((P.x+Math.sin(a)*2)/1.2)*1.2,cz=Math.round((P.z+Math.cos(a)*2)/1.2)*1.2;let k=0;blocks.forEach(b=>{if(Math.abs(b.x-cx)<.01&&Math.abs(b.z-cz)<.01&&b.t!='f'&&b.k>=k)k=b.k+1});if(bsel!='f'&&Math.abs(P.x-cx)<.9&&Math.abs(P.z-cz)<.9&&P.y<k*1.2+1.2)return msg('안쪽에는 지을 수 없어요');Object.keys(c).forEach(x=>inv[x]-=c[x]);place(bsel,cx,cz,k);sfx('build');qadd('build',1);invUI()}
function unbuild(){let best=null,bd=4;blocks.forEach(b=>{const d=Math.hypot(b.x-P.x,b.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=b}});if(!best)return msg('철거할 블록이 없어요');sc.remove(best.m);blocks=blocks.filter(x=>x!=best);const c=BC[best.t];Object.keys(c).forEach(x=>inv[x]=(inv[x]||0)+c[x]);sfx('build');invUI()}
let busy=false,hist=[];
function line(w,t){const d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=w+': '+t;$('#ql').appendChild(d);$('#ql').scrollTop=1e5;return d}
function chatT(v){const c=$('#chat');if(!c)return;c.style.display=v?'block':'none';keys={};if(v){if(!$('#ql').children.length)line('🦫 '+names.c,'안녕하세요 '+names.p+'님! 궁금한 걸 물어보세요.');$('#qi').focus()}else $('#qi').blur()}
async function ask(){const i=$('#qi'),q=i.value.trim();if(!q||busy)return;i.value='';line('🧑 '+names.p,q);busy=true;const el=line('🦫 '+names.c,'생각 중…');
try{const sm=await claude.use('sample');if(!sm)throw new Error('x');
const st='HP '+Math.ceil(P.hp)+'/20, '+(isN?'밤':'낮')+', 인벤토리: '+(Object.keys(inv).filter(k=>inv[k]>0).map(k=>N[k]+inv[k]).join(', ')||'비어 있음')+', 퀘스트: '+(Q[qi]?Q[qi].x+' '+qp+'/'+Q[qi].n:'모두 완료');
const sys='너는 3D 생존 RPG 막짱 RPG의 도우미 카피바라 AI '+names.c+'이다. 플레이어 '+names.p+'님에게 친근하고 귀여운 존댓말로 한국어 2~3문장 안에서 답해라. 조작: WASD 이동, Space 점프, Shift 웅크리기, Ctrl 슬라이딩, Enter 공격/채집, F 줍기, I 인벤토리/제작, 1·2·3 블록 선택, R 설치, X 철거, Q 질문, E 대화, H 물약, Z 회전베기, V 치유. 던전은 북쪽 끝 해안에 있고 보스는 석상 왕이다. 규칙: 맨손으로 나무 채집, 목재 3개로 곡괭이 제작, 돌 채굴 시 20% 철광석, 철광석으로 철검 제작, 낮 2분 밤 1분, 밤엔 늑대 멧돼지 곰이 나오며 마을(흰 원) 안은 안전. 현재 상태: '+st+'. 아래 대화에 이어 카피바라 AI의 답만 써라. ';
const r=await sm(sys+hist.slice(-6).join(' / ')+' / 플레이어: '+q+' / '+names.c+':',{cache:false,modelTier:'quick',onText:({text})=>{el.textContent='🦫 '+names.c+': '+text}});
hist.push('플레이어: '+q,names.c+': '+r.text)}catch(e){el.textContent='🦫 '+names.c+': 지금은 AI와 연결할 수 없어요. (AI 연결 권한을 허용했는지 확인해 주세요)'}busy=false}
let trees,rocks,items,wolves,amb,sun,pl,cp,isN=false,br=1,msgT,hintT=15,I,keys={},cy=0,cpit=.5,blocks=[],qi=0,qp=0,nn=0,bsel='w',npcs=[],vl=0,bossDead=false,inD=false,dlgN=null;let DX=500,dk=0;
const S={t:0},P={x:0,y:0,z:20,vy:0,hp:20,mx:20,mp:20,mmx:20,lv:1,xp:0,g:30,wl:0,sk:0,sl:0,cd:0,ac:0,sw:0,hit:0,sdx:0,sdz:0,tm:0};
const rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
function world(){sc=new T.Scene();sc.background=new T.Color('#8ecaff');trees=[];rocks=[];items=[];wolves=[];S.t=0;isN=false;br=1;P.y=0;blocks=[];qi=0;qp=0;nn=0;P.mx=20;P.hp=20;P.mp=20;P.mmx=20;P.lv=1;P.xp=0;P.g=30;P.wl=0;vl=0;bossDead=false;inD=false;npcs=[];sc.fog=new T.Fog(0x8ecaff,90,280);eq={w:null,a:null};chest={};P.pz=0;inI=-1;dk=0;DX=500;curB='';buildVillage();dungeon();
amb=new T.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.6);sun=new T.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.8);sun.position.set(30,60,20);sc.add(amb,sun);
const sea=new T.Mesh(new T.PlaneGeometry(600,600),M('#2e86de'));sea.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;sea.position.y=-.4;sc.add(sea);
[[280,282,.6,'#f0d9a0',-.3],[270,272,.62,'#58a64a',-.29],[24,24,.7,'#c9b27c',-.28]].forEach(a=>{const m=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(a[0],a[1],a[2],40),M(a[3]));m.receiveShadow=true;m.position.y=a[4];sc.add(m)});
const ring=new T.Mesh(new T.RingGeometry(24,24.4,64),M('#fff'));ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;ring.position.y=.08;sc.add(ring);
for(let i=0;i<0;i++){const a=i*1.2566,g=new T.Group();bx(g,4,3,4,'#d9a066',0,1.5,0);const r=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(3.6,2,4),M('#a0392b'));r.position.y=4;r.rotation.y=.785;g.add(r);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*9,0,Math.sin(a)*9);sc.add(g)}
for(let i=0;i<110;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(28,104),g=new T.Group();bx(g,.6,2.4,.6,'#7b4a1e',0,1.2,0);bx(g,2.6,2.2,2.6,'#2e8b3d',0,3.3,0);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,Math.sin(a)*r);sc.add(g);trees.push({m:g,hp:3})}
for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(28,104),m=new T.Mesh(new T.DodecahedronGeometry(1.1),M('#8d949c'));m.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,.7,Math.sin(a)*r);sc.add(m);rocks.push({m,hp:4})}}
/* 인트로 */
function intro(){mode='intro';world();const g=new T.Group();bx(g,1.4,1.4,6,'#ecf0f1');bx(g,9,.2,1.4,'#e74c3c',0,0,.3);bx(g,3,.2,.9,'#e74c3c',0,.3,-2.6);bx(g,.2,1.4,.9,'#e74c3c',0,.9,-2.6);sc.add(g);I={t:0,g,p6:new T.Vector3(),done:false};
screen('<div class="cut" id="ct">✈️ 평화로운 하늘 여행 중…</div>','')}
function introU(dt){I.t+=dt;const t=I.t,g=I.g,ct=$('#ct');
if(t<6){const a=t*.5;g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*45,45,Math.sin(a)*45);g.rotation.y=-a;g.rotation.z=t>3?Math.sin(t*14)*.25:0;I.p6.copy(g.position);cam.position.set(0,5,60);cam.lookAt(g.position);ct&&(ct.textContent=t<3?'✈️ 평화로운 하늘 여행 중…':'⚠️ 엔진 고장! 비행기가 흔들린다!')}
else if(t<10){const u=(t-6)/4;g.position.lerpVectors(I.p6,new T.Vector3(0,1.2,24),u);g.rotation.x=.5*u;g.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*14)*.2*(1-u);cam.position.set(-25,8,45);cam.lookAt(g.position);ct&&(ct.textContent='🛬 추락한다!!')}
else{g.rotation.set(0,0,0);cam.position.set(-18+Math.sin(t*40)*Math.max(0,11-t)*.3,8,40);cam.lookAt(0,2,24);ct&&(ct.textContent='쿵! 섬에 불시착했다…');if(t>12&&!I.done){I.done=true;mode='wait';nameUI()}}}
function nameUI(){screen('<h2>이름을 정해주세요</h2><input id="np" placeholder="플레이어 이름" maxlength="10"><input id="nc" placeholder="카피바라 AI 이름" maxlength="10"><button class="b go" onclick="setNames()">확인</button>')}
function setNames(){names.p=$('#np').value.trim()||'모험가';names.c=$('#nc').value.trim()||'카피';P.x=0;P.z=20;startPlay(false)}
/* 플레이 */
function startPlay(c){pl=human(look);cp=capy(look);sc.add(pl,cp);cp.position.set(P.x+2,0,P.z+2);
if(!c)inv={};mode='play';cy=0;
screen('<div class="hud"><div id="nm"></div><div class="hp"><i id="hpb"></i></div><div class="hp mp"><i id="mpb"></i></div><div id="lvl"></div><div id="clk"></div><div id="qs"></div></div><div id="bossb"><div id="bbn"></div><div class="hp" style="width:300px"><i id="bbi"></i></div></div><div id="dlg"></div><div id="tk"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="cap"></div><div id="inv"></div><div id="chat"><div id="ql"></div><input id="qi" placeholder="카피바라에게 질문 (Enter 전송, Esc 닫기)" onkeydown="if(event.keyCode==13)ask();if(event.keyCode==27||(event.code==\'KeyQ\'&&!this.value)){event.preventDefault();chatT(false)}"><button class="b" onclick="ask()">전송</button></div><div id="hint">WASD 이동 · Space 점프 · Shift 웅크리기 · Ctrl 슬라이딩 · Enter 공격/채집 · F 줍기 · I 인벤토리/제작 · 1~4 블록(4=제작대) · R 설치 · X 철거 · Q 카피바라에게 질문 · E 대화 · H 물약 · Z 회전베기 · V 치유 · 마우스 드래그 시점</div>','');
$('#nm').textContent='🧑 '+names.p+'  |  🦫 '+names.c;msg(c?'이어서 플레이합니다!':'섬 탐험을 시작하세요! 나무 앞에서 Enter를 눌러 보세요.')}
function msg(t){const e=$('#msg');if(!e)return;e.textContent=t;clearTimeout(msgT);msgT=setTimeout(()=>e.textContent='',3000)}
const N={wood:'목재',stone:'돌',iron:'철광석',wpick:'나무 곡괭이',ipick:'철 곡괭이',wsword:'나무 검',ssword:'돌 검',isword:'철 검',dsword:'용사의 검',warmor:'나무 갑옷',iarmor:'철 갑옷',potion:'체력 물약',gem:'보석'},
RC={wpick:{wood:3},ipick:{wood:2,iron:3},wsword:{wood:4},ssword:{wood:2,stone:3},isword:{wood:2,iron:3},warmor:{wood:6},iarmor:{wood:2,iron:6}},DC={wood:'#a0652a',stone:'#999',iron:'#d98e5f',potion:'#e84393',gem:'#6c5ce7'};
function invUI(){const e=$('#inv');if(!e)return;const ks=Object.keys(inv).filter(k=>inv[k]>0);
e.innerHTML='<b>🎒 인벤토리</b><br>'+(ks.length?ks.map(k=>N[k]+' ×'+inv[k]).join('<br>'):'비어 있음')+'<hr><b>🔨 제작</b><br>'+Object.keys(RC).map(k=>'<button class="b" onclick="craft(\''+k+'\')">'+N[k]+' ('+Object.keys(RC[k]).map(r=>N[r]+RC[k][r]).join(', ')+')</button>').join('')}
function craft(k){const r=RC[k];if(!Object.keys(r).every(x=>(inv[x]||0)>=r[x]))return msg('재료가 부족해요');Object.keys(r).forEach(x=>inv[x]-=r[x]);inv[k]=(inv[k]||0)+1;msg(N[k]+' 제작 완료!');invUI();sfx('ok');qadd(/pick/.test(k)?'pick':'sword',1)}
function drop(t,p,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const m=bx(sc,.4,.4,.4,DC[t],p.x+rnd(-1.5,1.5),.3,p.z+rnd(-1.5,1.5));items.push({t,m})}}
function act(){if(P.ac>0)return;P.ac=.35;P.sw=.25;let best=null,bd=3.4;const ck=(o,t)=>{const d=Math.hypot(o.m.position.x-P.x,o.m.position.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;best={o,t}}};
trees.forEach(o=>ck(o,'tree'));rocks.forEach(o=>ck(o,'rock'));wolves.forEach(o=>ck(o,'wolf'));
if(!best)return msg('가까이에 대상이 없어요');const o=best.o;
if(best.t=='tree'){sfx('chop');o.hp--;o.m.rotation.z=.1;setTimeout(()=>o.m.rotation.z=0,100);if(o.hp<=0){sc.remove(o.m);trees=trees.filter(x=>x!=o);drop('wood',o.m.position,3);msg('목재가 떨어졌다! F로 줍기')}}
else if(best.t=='rock'){if(!inv.wpick&&!inv.ipick)return msg('곡괭이가 필요해요! (I → 제작)');sfx('mine');o.hp-=inv.ipick?2:1;if(o.hp<=0){sc.remove(o.m);rocks=rocks.filter(x=>x!=o);drop('stone',o.m.position,2);if(Math.random()<.2){drop('iron',o.m.position,1);msg('⛏️ 철광석 발견!')}}}
else{o.hp-=dmg();sfx('hit');if(o.hp<=0)kill(o);else if(o.boss)bossCheck(o);else o.m.position.add(new T.Vector3(o.m.position.x-P.x,0,o.m.position.z-P.z).normalize().multiplyScalar(1.2))}}
function pick(){let b=null,bd=3;items.forEach(i=>{const d=Math.hypot(i.m.position.x-P.x,i.m.position.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;b=i}});if(!b)return;sc.remove(b.m);items=items.filter(x=>x!=b);inv[b.t]=(inv[b.t]||0)+1;msg(N[b.t]+' +1');invUI();sfx('pick');qadd(b.t,1)}
function wolf(){const g=new T.Group();bx(g,.7,.7,1.4,'#4a4a52',0,.7,0);bx(g,.5,.5,.5,'#4a4a52',0,.95,.85);[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>bx(g,.1,.1,.05,'#f00',x,1.05,1.12));[[-.25,-.5],[.25,-.5],[-.25,.5],[.25,.5]].forEach(p=>bx(g,.15,.4,.15,'#333',p[0],.2,p[1]));return g}
const XP={'늑대':10,'멧돼지':18,'곰':40,'해골':14,'석상 왕':300},SH=[['potion',25,1],['wood',20,5],['stone',30,5]],SL=[['wood',3],['stone',5],['iron',25],['gem',100]];
const VL=['오늘도 평화롭네요!','밤에는 마을 밖으로 나가지 마세요.','던전의 보스가 무섭대요…','촌장님께 기부하면 마을이 커져요!','대장장이 철수의 강화 솜씨는 최고예요.'],VN=['미나','철민','수아','도윤','하준','서연','지우','예준'];
function dmg(){let b=inv.dsword?12:inv.isword?6:inv.ssword?4:inv.wsword?3:1;b+=P.wl*2+P.lv;if(Math.random()<.1){b*=2;msg('치명타!')}return b}
function armor(){return inv.iarmor?.45:inv.warmor?.2:0}
function gainXp(n){P.xp+=n;let need=P.lv*40+20;while(P.xp>=need){P.xp-=need;P.lv++;P.mx+=5;P.mmx+=3;P.hp=P.mx;P.mp=P.mmx;msg('⭐ 레벨 업! Lv.'+P.lv);sfx('ok');qadd('lv',1);need=P.lv*40+20}}
function kill(o){sc.remove(o.m);wolves=wolves.filter(x=>x!=o);const xp=XP[o.n]||10,g=Math.round(xp/2+rnd(0,5));P.g+=g;gainXp(xp);msg(o.n+' 처치! +'+xp+'XP +'+g+'G');qadd('kill',1);if(Math.random()<.25)drop('potion',o.m.position,1);if(o.boss){bossDead=true;qadd('boss',1);drop('gem',o.m.position,5);inv.dsword=1;msg('🏆 보스 처치! 용사의 검 획득!');sfx('ok');invUI()}}
function bossCheck(o){if(!o.ph&&o.hp<o.mhp/2){o.ph=1;for(let i=0;i<4;i++)mob('해골',DX+rnd(-10,10),rnd(-10,10));msg('석상 왕이 해골병사를 소환했다!')}}
function usePot(){if(!(inv.potion>0))return msg('물약이 없어요');inv.potion--;P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+15);sfx('ok');msg('물약 사용! HP +15');invUI()}
function skill(k){if(P.sk>0)return;if(k=='z'){if(P.mp<8)return msg('MP가 부족해요');P.mp-=8;P.sk=3;P.sw=.4;sfx('hit');let n=0;wolves.slice().forEach(o=>{if(Math.hypot(o.m.position.x-P.x,o.m.position.z-P.z)<4.5){o.hp-=dmg()*2;n++;if(o.hp<=0)kill(o);else if(o.boss)bossCheck(o)}});msg('회전 베기! '+n+'마리 명중')}else{if(P.mp<10)return msg('MP가 부족해요');P.mp-=10;P.sk=4;P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+12);sfx('ok');msg('치유의 빛! HP +12')}}
function mob(n,x,z){const m=new T.Group(),b=n=='석상 왕';if(b){bx(m,1.6,2,1,'#7f8c8d',0,2,0);bx(m,.9,.9,.9,'#95a5a6',0,3.5,0);[-.25,.25].forEach(a=>bx(m,.2,.2,.1,'#ff3b30',a,3.6,.46));[-1.2,1.2].forEach(a=>bx(m,.6,1.8,.6,'#7f8c8d',a,2,0));[-.5,.5].forEach(a=>bx(m,.7,1.2,.7,'#6c7a7b',a,.6,0));bx(m,1.2,.3,1.2,'#f1c40f',0,4.1,0)}else{bx(m,.45,.45,.45,'#ecebe0',0,1.65,0);bx(m,.5,.7,.25,'#d8d6c8',0,1.1,0);[-.1,.1].forEach(a=>bx(m,.08,.08,.04,'#f33',a,1.68,.23));[-.32,.32].forEach(a=>bx(m,.12,.65,.12,'#ecebe0',a,1.1,0));[-.13,.13].forEach(a=>bx(m,.14,.75,.14,'#ecebe0',a,.38,0))}m.position.set(x,0,z);sc.add(m);const hp=b?160:14;wolves.push({m,hp,mhp:hp,a:0,n,s:b?2.2:1,dmg:b?8:3,sp:b?2.8:3.6,d:true,boss:b})}
function enterD(){inD=true;P.x=DX;P.z=14;P.vy=0;P.y=0;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)mob('해골',DX+rnd(-15,15),rnd(-15,5));if(!bossDead)mob('석상 왕',DX,-12);msg('🕳️ 던전 진입! 석상 왕이 기다린다…');sfx('build')}
function leaveD(){inD=false;wolves.filter(w=>w.d).forEach(w=>sc.remove(w.m));wolves=wolves.filter(w=>!w.d);P.x=0;P.z=-88;P.y=0;msg('던전을 빠져나왔다.')}
function dungeon(){const g=new T.Group(),mw='#4b4f58';bx(g,40,.6,40,'#2f3238',DX,-.3,0);[-20,20].forEach(z=>bx(g,40,8,1,mw,DX,4,z));[-20,20].forEach(x=>bx(g,1,8,40,mw,DX+x,4,0));bx(g,41,1,41,'#222',DX,9,0);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=DX+(i%2?1:-1)*10,z=(i<2?-1:1)*10;bx(g,1.4,8,1.4,'#5d626c',x,4,z);const L=new T.PointLight(0xff9a3c,.9,26);L.position.set(x,5,z);g.add(L);bx(g,.4,.4,.4,'#ff8c1a',x,5,z)}const ex=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(1.6,1.6,.2,24),M('#8e44ff'));ex.position.set(DX,.1,19);g.add(ex);sc.add(g);const e=new T.Group();bx(e,1.4,6,1.4,'#666',-3,3,0);bx(e,1.4,6,1.4,'#666',3,3,0);bx(e,8,1.4,1.6,'#555',0,6.5,0);const p=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(2.4,2.4,.2,24),M('#8e44ff'));p.position.y=.1;e.add(p);const lb=label('던전 입구','#d6a2ff');lb.position.y=8.5;e.add(lb);e.position.set(0,0,-96);sc.add(e)}
function label(t,col){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=256;c.height=64;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.font='bold 30px sans-serif';x.textAlign='center';x.fillStyle='#000a';x.fillRect(0,8,256,48);x.fillStyle=col||'#fff';x.fillText(t,128,44);const s=new T.Sprite(new T.SpriteMaterial({map:new T.CanvasTexture(c),transparent:true}));s.scale.set(3,.75,1);return s}
function addHouse(i){const a=i<6?i*1.047:(i-6)*.785+.39,r=i<6?12:20,g=new T.Group();bx(g,4,3,4,['#d9a066','#c98f5a','#e0b07a','#b97d4a'][i%4],0,1.5,0);bx(g,.9,1.8,.1,'#5a3a1a',0,.9,2.02);bx(g,1,1,.1,'#9ad1ff',1.2,1.8,2.02);const rf=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(3.6,2,4),M(['#a0392b','#2c6fb0','#7d5ba6'][i%3]));rf.position.y=4;rf.rotation.y=.785;rf.castShadow=true;g.add(rf);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,Math.sin(a)*r);g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(-Math.cos(a),-Math.sin(a));sc.add(g)}
function addNPC(n,k,x,z,c,h,l){const m=new T.Group();bx(m,.5,.5,.5,'#f1c27d',0,1.75,0);bx(m,.56,.2,.56,h,0,2.08,0);bx(m,.6,.7,.3,c,0,1.15,0);[-.15,.15].forEach(a=>bx(m,.25,.8,.25,'#333',a,.4,0));[-.4,.4].forEach(a=>bx(m,.18,.65,.18,c,a,1.15,0));m.position.set(x,0,z);const lb=label(n,k=='v'?'#fff':'#ffe08a');lb.position.y=2.9;m.add(lb);sc.add(m);npcs.push({m,n,k,l,t:0,a:0,mv:false})}
function addVill(){const i=npcs.length;addNPC(VN[i%8],'v',rnd(-14,14),rnd(-14,14),PC[i%6],['#8b5a2b','#333','#c0392b','#2c3e50'][i%4],VL[i%5])}
function buildVillage(){for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addHouse(i);const f=new T.Group();bx(f,4,.6,4,'#8d949c',0,.3,0);bx(f,3,.5,3,'#3fa7ff',0,.55,0);bx(f,.5,1.8,.5,'#aab',0,1.2,0);sc.add(f);for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i*.785+.2,g=new T.Group();bx(g,.2,3,.2,'#3a3a3a',0,1.5,0);bx(g,.5,.5,.5,'#ffe08a',0,3.1,0);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*7,0,Math.sin(a)*7);sc.add(g)}[['촌장 하늘','chief',4,-5,'#8e44ad','#ecf0f1'],['상인 모모','shop',-6,4,'#e67e22','#d35400'],['대장장이 철수','smith',7,6,'#7f8c8d','#2c3e50'],['경비병 강','guard',0,19,'#2c3e50','#bdc3c7']].forEach(a=>addNPC(a[0],a[1],a[2],a[3],a[4],a[5]));addVill();addVill()}
function npcU(dt){let near=null,bd=4;npcs.forEach(n=>{const p=n.m.position,d=Math.hypot(p.x-P.x,p.z-P.z);if(n.k=='v'){n.t-=dt;if(n.t<0){n.t=rnd(1,4);n.a=rnd(0,6.28);n.mv=Math.random()<.6}if(n.mv&&d>3){p.x+=Math.cos(n.a)*1.2*dt;p.z+=Math.sin(n.a)*1.2*dt;n.m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(Math.cos(n.a),Math.sin(n.a));if(Math.hypot(p.x,p.z)>21)n.a=Math.atan2(-p.z,-p.x)}}else if(d<8)n.m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(P.x-p.x,P.z-p.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;near=n}});$('#tk').textContent=near&&!inD?'E : '+near.n+'와(과) 대화':'';if(dlgN&&(!near||near!=dlgN))closeDlg();if(!inD&&Math.hypot(P.x,P.z+96)<2.5)enterD();else if(inD&&Math.hypot(P.x-DX,P.z-19)<2.2)leaveD()}
function closeDlg(){dlgN=null;const d=$('#dlg');if(d)d.style.display='none'}
function talk(){let b=null,bd=4;npcs.forEach(n=>{const d=Math.hypot(n.m.position.x-P.x,n.m.position.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;b=n}});if(!b)return;dlgN=b;dlgU()}
function dlgU(){const n=dlgN,d=$('#dlg');if(!n)return;d.style.display='block';const B=(t,f)=>'<button class=b onclick='+f+'>'+t+'</button>',q=Q[qi];let h='<b>'+n.n+'</b><br>';if(n.k=='chief')h+='“어서 와요, '+names.p+'님. 마을 레벨 '+vl+'/8. '+(q?'지금 할 일: '+q.x+'.':'모든 임무를 완수했군요! 영웅이에요!')+'”<br>'+B('마을 발전 기부 (100G)','donate()');else if(n.k=='shop')h+='“어서 오세요! 보유 골드 '+P.g+'G”<br>'+B('체력 물약 (25G)','buy(0)')+B('목재 ×5 (20G)','buy(1)')+B('돌 ×5 (30G)','buy(2)')+'<br>'+B('목재 판매 (개당 3G)','sell(0)')+B('돌 판매 (5G)','sell(1)')+B('철광석 판매 (25G)','sell(2)')+B('보석 판매 (100G)','sell(3)');else if(n.k=='smith')h+='“무기를 강화해 주지. 현재 +'+P.wl+' (최대 +5)”<br>'+(P.wl<5?B('강화: 철광석 '+(P.wl+1)*2+'개 + '+(P.wl+1)*60+'G','forge()'):'최대 강화!');else if(n.k=='guard')h+='“북쪽 끝 해안에 던전 입구가 있소. 안에는 석상 왕이 산다오… 충분히 강해진 뒤에 가시오! (보라색 문이 던전 입구요)”';else h+='“'+n.l+'”';d.innerHTML=h+'<br>'+B('닫기','closeDlg()')}
function buy(i){const a=SH[i];if(P.g<a[1])return msg('골드가 부족해요');P.g-=a[1];inv[a[0]]=(inv[a[0]]||0)+a[2];sfx('pick');dlgU();invUI()}
function sell(i){const a=SL[i],c=inv[a[0]]||0;if(!c)return msg('팔 물건이 없어요');P.g+=c*a[1];inv[a[0]]=0;sfx('ok');dlgU();invUI()}
function forge(){const w=P.wl+1;if((inv.iron||0)<w*2||P.g<w*60)return msg('재료 또는 골드가 부족해요');inv.iron-=w*2;P.g-=w*60;P.wl++;sfx('ok');msg('무기 강화 성공! +'+P.wl);dlgU();invUI()}
function donate(){if(vl>=8)return msg('마을이 최대로 발전했어요!');if(P.g<100)return msg('골드가 부족해요');P.g-=100;vl++;addHouse(5+vl);addVill();gainXp(30);sfx('build');msg('🏘️ 마을이 발전했어요! (Lv.'+vl+')');dlgU()}
function shadowU(){if(!sun.castShadow){sun.castShadow=true;sun.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);const c=sun.shadow.camera;c.left=c.bottom=-45;c.right=c.top=45;c.far=200;c.updateProjectionMatrix();sc.add(sun.target)}sun.position.set(P.x+30,P.y+60,P.z+20);sun.target.position.set(P.x,0,P.z);sc.fog.color.copy(sc.background)}
function hudU(){$('#lvl').textContent='Lv.'+P.lv+' ('+P.xp+'/'+(P.lv*40+20)+')  💰'+P.g+'  ⚔️+'+P.wl+'  🧪'+(inv.potion||0);$('#mpb').style.width=P.mp/P.mmx*100+'%';const b=wolves.find(w=>w.boss),e=$('#bossb');e.style.display=b?'block':'none';if(b){$('#bbi').style.width=Math.max(0,b.hp/b.mhp*100)+'%';$('#bbn').textContent='💀 '+b.n}}
function drawMM(){const c=$('#mm').getContext('2d');c.clearRect(0,0,120,120);c.fillStyle=inD?'#222':'#2f6b3a';c.beginPath();c.arc(60,60,60,0,6.3);c.fill();const dot=(x,z,col,r)=>{const px=60+(x-P.x),py=60+(z-P.z);if(Math.hypot(px-60,py-60)<57){c.fillStyle=col;c.beginPath();c.arc(px,py,r,0,6.3);c.fill()}};if(!inD){c.strokeStyle='#fff8';c.beginPath();c.arc(60-P.x,60-P.z,24,0,6.3);c.stroke();dot(0,-96,'#b36bff',4)}npcs.forEach(n=>dot(n.m.position.x,n.m.position.z,'#f1c40f',3));wolves.forEach(w=>dot(w.m.position.x,w.m.position.z,w.boss?'#ff2d2d':'#e74c3c',w.boss?5:3));dot(P.x,P.z,'#fff',4)}
function spawnWOld(){for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(35,65),m=wolf();m.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,Math.sin(a)*r);sc.add(m);wolves.push({m,hp:8,a})}}
function clearW(){wolves.filter(w=>!w.d).forEach(w=>sc.remove(w.m));wolves=wolves.filter(w=>w.d)}
const cD=new T.Color('#8ecaff'),cN=new T.Color('#0a1030');
const HINTS=['나무 앞에서 Enter로 캐고, 떨어진 목재는 F로 주워요!','목재 3개로 곡괭이를 만들 수 있어요. (I 키)','돌을 캘 때 20% 확률로 철광석이 나와요!','밤에는 마을 안(흰 원 안)이 안전해요!','철광석으로 더 강한 무기를 만들어 보세요!'];
function upd(dt){S.t+=dt;const ph=S.t%180,night=ph>=120;
if(night!==isN){isN=night;night?spawnW():clearW();msg(night?'🌙 밤이 되었어요! 마을 안으로 대피하세요!':'🌞 아침이 밝았어요!')}
br+=((night?.15:1)-br)*dt;shadowU();amb.intensity=.15+.5*br;sun.intensity=.05+.8*br;sc.background.copy(cN).lerp(cD,br);
$('#clk').textContent=(night?'🌙 밤 ':'🌞 낮 ')+Math.ceil(night?180-ph:120-ph)+'초';qUI();
let ix=(keys.KeyD?1:0)-(keys.KeyA?1:0),iz=(keys.KeyS?1:0)-(keys.KeyW?1:0);const cr=keys.ShiftLeft||keys.ShiftRight;let mx=0,mz=0,mv=ix||iz;
if(mv){const l=Math.hypot(ix,iz);ix/=l;iz/=l;const s=Math.sin(cy),c=Math.cos(cy);mx=ix*c+iz*s;mz=-ix*s+iz*c}
P.cd-=dt;if((keys.ControlLeft||keys.ControlRight)&&P.cd<=0&&mv){P.sl=.6;P.cd=1.4;P.sdx=mx;P.sdz=mz}
let sp=cr?2.5:7.5;if(P.sl>0){P.sl-=dt;mx=P.sdx;mz=P.sdz;sp=12;mv=true}
P.x+=mx*sp*dt;P.z+=mz*sp*dt;const r=Math.hypot(P.x,P.z);if(!inD&&inI<0&&r>265){P.x*=265/r;P.z*=265/r}if(inD){P.x=Math.max(DX-18,Math.min(DX+18,P.x));P.z=Math.max(-18,Math.min(18,P.z))}if(inI>=0){const ix0=900+inI*30;P.x=Math.max(ix0-5.8,Math.min(ix0+5.8,P.x));P.z=Math.max(-5.8,Math.min(5.8,P.z))}bioU(dt);
let gy=0;blocks.forEach(b=>{if(b.t=='f')return;const ox=.9-Math.abs(P.x-b.x),oz=.9-Math.abs(P.z-b.z);if(ox>0&&oz>0){const tp=b.y+.6;if(P.y>=tp-.3)gy=Math.max(gy,tp);else if(P.y+1.8>b.y-.6){if(ox<oz)P.x+=(P.x>=b.x?1:-1)*ox;else P.z+=(P.z>=b.z?1:-1)*oz}}});if(keys.Space&&P.y<=gy+.05&&P.vy<=0){P.vy=8;sfx('jump')}P.vy-=22*dt;P.y+=P.vy*dt;if(P.y<gy){P.y=gy;P.vy=0}
P.tm+=dt*(mv?14:0);const am=mv?1.1:0,run=mv&&!cr&&P.sl<=0;pl.position.set(P.x,P.y,P.z);if(mv)pl.rotation.y=Math.atan2(mx,mz);pl.scale.y=cr?.8:1;pl.rotation.x=P.sl>0?.9:run?.38:0;
pl.lL.rotation.x=Math.sin(P.tm)*am;pl.lR.rotation.x=-Math.sin(P.tm)*am;pl.aL.rotation.x=run?1.3:-Math.sin(P.tm)*am;pl.aR.rotation.x=run?1.3:Math.sin(P.tm)*am;
P.ac-=dt;if(P.sw>0){P.sw-=dt;pl.aR.rotation.x=-1.6}
const cd=inI>=0?3.6:7,d=Math.cos(cpit)*cd;cam.position.set(P.x+Math.sin(cy)*d,P.y+1.5+Math.sin(cpit)*cd,P.z+Math.cos(cy)*d);cam.lookAt(P.x,P.y+1.3,P.z);
const tx=P.x-Math.sin(cy)*2.5+1.5,tz=P.z-Math.cos(cy)*2.5,cx=tx-cp.position.x,cz=tz-cp.position.z;cp.position.x+=cx*dt*3;cp.position.z+=cz*dt*3;if(Math.hypot(cx,cz)>.3)cp.rotation.y=Math.atan2(cx,cz);
npcU(dt);P.sk-=dt;P.hit-=dt;wolves.forEach(w=>{const p=w.m.position,dx=P.x-p.x,dz=P.z-p.z,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dz);let vx,vz;if(w.pa&&dd<14){vx=-dx/dd;vz=-dz/dd}else if(!w.pa&&dd<30){vx=dx/dd;vz=dz/dd}else{w.a+=(Math.random()-.5)*dt*2;vx=Math.cos(w.a)*.4;vz=Math.sin(w.a)*.4}
p.x+=vx*w.sp*dt;p.z+=vz*w.sp*dt;const q=Math.hypot(p.x,p.z)||1;if(w.d){p.x=Math.max(DX-18,Math.min(DX+18,p.x));p.z=Math.max(-18,Math.min(18,p.z))}else{if(q<25){p.x*=25/q;p.z*=25/q}if(q>265){p.x*=265/q;p.z*=265/q}}w.m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(vx,vz);
if(dd<1.6*w.s&&P.hit<=0&&r>=23&&!w.pa){P.hp-=Math.max(1,Math.round(w.dmg*(1-armor())));P.hit=1;sfx('hurt');msg(w.n+'에게 물렸다!')}});
if((r<23||inI>=0)&&!inD&&P.hp<P.mx)P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+dt);P.mp=Math.min(P.mmx,P.mp+dt*1.5);
if(P.hp<=0){P.hp=P.mx;P.x=0;P.z=0;if(inD)leaveD();P.g=Math.floor(P.g*.9);msg('기절했다… 마을에서 깨어났다.')}
$('#hpb').style.width=P.hp/P.mx*100+'%';hudU();items.forEach(i=>{i.m.position.y=.4+Math.sin(S.t*3)*.08;i.m.rotation.y+=dt});
hintT-=dt;if(hintT<=0){hintT=22;const e=$('#cap');e.style.display='block';e.textContent='🦫 '+names.c+': '+(isN?HINTS[3]:(!inv.wpick&&!inv.ipick)?HINTS[Math.floor(rnd(0,3))]:HINTS[Math.floor(rnd(0,5))]);setTimeout(()=>e.style.display='none',6000)}}
setInterval(()=>{if(mode=='play')ls.s('mj_save_'+user,JSON.stringify({look,names,inv,t:S.t,x:inD?0:P.x,z:inD?-88:P.z,ps:{mx:P.mx,mmx:P.mmx,lv:P.lv,xp:P.xp,g:P.g,wl:P.wl},eq,chest,vl,bd:bossDead,qi,qp,bl:blocks.map(b=>[b.t,b.x,b.z,b.k]),time:Date.now()}))},5000);
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.tagName=='INPUT')return;if(['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Tab','Enter'].includes(e.code)&&mode=='play')e.preventDefault();
keys[e.code]=true;if(mode!='play'||e.repeat)return;if(e.code=='KeyQ'){e.preventDefault();chatT($('#chat').style.display!='block');return}if(e.code=='Digit1'||e.code=='Digit2'||e.code=='Digit3'||e.code=='Digit4'){bsel=['w','s','f','t'][+e.key-1];msg('선택: '+BN[bsel])}if(e.code=='KeyR')build();if(e.code=='KeyX')unbuild();if(e.code=='KeyE')talk();if(e.code=='KeyH')usePot();if(e.code=='KeyG')usePoison();if(e.code=='KeyZ')skill('z');if(e.code=='KeyV')skill('v');if(e.code=='Escape')closeDlg();
if(e.code=='Enter')act();if(e.code=='KeyF')pick();if(e.code=='KeyI'){const v=$('#inv');v.style.display=v.style.display=='block'?'none':'block';invUI()}});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);addEventListener('blur',()=>keys={});
let drag=false,lx=0,ly=0;const cv=$('#c');cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag=true;lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY});addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag)return;cy-=(e.clientX-lx)*.006;cpit=Math.min(1.2,Math.max(.05,cpit+(e.clientY-ly)*.005));lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY});
let last=0;function loop(ts){requestAnimationFrame(loop);const dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-last)/1000||0);last=ts;
if(mode=='creator'){cam.position.set(0,1.8,6.5);cam.lookAt(0,1.1,0);hm&&(hm.rotation.y+=dt*.7);cm&&(cm.rotation.y+=dt*.7)}else if(mode=='intro')introU(dt);else if(mode=='play')upd(dt);
R.render(sc,cam)}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);loading();
</script>
<script>
/* ===== v4 확장 ===== */
let eq={w:null,a:null},chest={},mt=[],lavas=[],inI=-1,curB='',HS=[],lastH=null,ILt=null,DCH=[];
const WD={fist:{d:1,cd:.35},wsword:{d:3,cd:.35},ssword:{d:4,cd:.35},isword:{d:6,cd:.35},dsword:{d:12,cd:.35},fsword:{d:18,cd:.35},dagger:{d:4,cd:.18},bow:{d:6,cd:.7,r:18,am:'arrow'},pistol:{d:8,cd:.45,r:24,am:'bullet'},gun:{d:11,cd:.22,r:28,am:'bullet'}};
const AR={warmor:.2,iarmor:.35,chain:.45,garmor:.55,darmor:.7};
const EQ={wsword:'w',ssword:'w',isword:'w',dsword:'w',fsword:'w',dagger:'w',bow:'w',pistol:'w',gun:'w',warmor:'a',iarmor:'a',chain:'a',garmor:'a',darmor:'a'};
Object.assign(N,{bow:'활',arrow:'화살',dagger:'단검',gun:'소총',pistol:'권총',bullet:'탄환',chain:'사슬 갑옷',garmor:'금 갑옷',darmor:'다이아 갑옷',fsword:'화염 검',poison:'독포션',goldore:'금광석',diamond:'다이아몬드',bread:'빵',meat:'고기'});
Object.assign(DC,{goldore:'#f1c40f',diamond:'#55efc4',meat:'#c0392b',bread:'#d9a066'});
Object.assign(BT,{'호랑이':{c:'#e67e22',s:1.2,hp:22,dmg:4,sp:5},'사자':{c:'#d4a645',s:1.3,hp:30,dmg:5,sp:4.6},'하이에나':{c:'#a08a5a',s:1,hp:16,dmg:3,sp:5.2},'북극곰':{c:'#f2f6fa',s:1.8,hp:40,dmg:6,sp:3.4},'불꽃 임프':{c:'#e74c3c',s:.9,hp:24,dmg:5,sp:4.8},'눈토끼':{c:'#fff',s:.8,hp:4,dmg:0,sp:5.5}});
Object.assign(XP,{'호랑이':30,'사자':40,'하이에나':20,'북극곰':50,'눈토끼':5,'불꽃 임프':40,'얼음 거인':450,'화염 드래곤':700});
Object.assign(BN,{t:'제작대'});Object.assign(BC,{t:{wood:4}});
const TN=['내 집','창고','상점','대장간','여관','도서관'],BIN={snow:'❄️ 설원 바이옴',city:'🏙️ 대도시 - 세상에서 가장 큰 도시',fire:'🌋 화염 바이옴',grass:'🌿 초원 바이옴'},ENT=[[0,-96,0],[0,-246,1],[-250,0,2]];
const PR={potion:['치유포션',25],poison:['독포션',30],bread:['빵',10]},SELLP={wood:3,stone:5,iron:25,goldore:60,diamond:150,gem:100,meat:8};
const FIN='불시착은 사고가 아니었어요. 하늘길을 막던 세 수호자 때문이었죠. 당신 덕분에 하늘이 열렸어요. 막짱 섬의 영웅이여, 고마워요! (이야기는 계속됩니다…)';
const RC2={bow:{c:{wood:3},n:1},arrow:{c:{wood:1,stone:1},n:10},dagger:{c:{iron:2,wood:1},n:1},pistol:{c:{iron:5,wood:2},n:1},gun:{c:{iron:8,wood:3},n:1},bullet:{c:{iron:1},n:10},isword:{c:{wood:2,iron:3},n:1},fsword:{c:{iron:10,goldore:3,diamond:2},n:1},iarmor:{c:{iron:6,wood:2},n:1},chain:{c:{iron:8},n:1},garmor:{c:{goldore:8},n:1},darmor:{c:{diamond:8},n:1}};
function biome(x,z){return Math.hypot(x,z+185)<78?'snow':Math.hypot(x-185,z)<80?'city':Math.hypot(x+185,z)<82?'fire':'grass'}
function hurt(d,t){P.hp-=Math.max(1,Math.round(d*(1-armor())));sfx('hurt');msg(t)}
/* 전투 */
function dmg(){const w=WD[eq.w||'fist'];let b=w.d+P.wl*2+P.lv;if(P.pz>0){P.pz--;b+=4}if(Math.random()<.1){b*=2;msg('치명타!')}return b}
function armor(){return AR[eq.a]||0}
function tracer(x,z,a,len){const m=bx(sc,.05,.05,len,'#ffe066',x+Math.sin(a)*len/2,1.3,z+Math.cos(a)*len/2);m.rotation.y=a;setTimeout(()=>sc.remove(m),90)}
function act(){if(P.ac>0)return;const w=WD[eq.w||'fist'];P.ac=w.cd;P.sw=.25;
if(w.r){if(!(inv[w.am]>0))return msg(N[w.am]+'이(가) 없어요! (제작대에서 제작)');inv[w.am]--;sfx('hit');const a=cy+Math.PI;pl.rotation.y=a;let best=null,bd=w.r;wolves.forEach(o=>{const dx=o.m.position.x-P.x,dz=o.m.position.z-P.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);let da=Math.abs(Math.atan2(dx,dz)-a);da=Math.min(da,6.283-da);if(d<bd&&da<.3){bd=d;best=o}});tracer(P.x,P.z,a,best?bd:w.r);if(best){best.hp-=dmg();if(best.hp<=0)kill(best);else if(best.boss)bossCheck(best)}return invUI()}
let best=null,bd=3.4;const ck=(o,t)=>{const d=Math.hypot(o.m.position.x-P.x,o.m.position.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;best={o,t}}};
trees.forEach(o=>ck(o,'tree'));rocks.forEach(o=>ck(o,'rock'));wolves.forEach(o=>ck(o,'wolf'));
if(!best)return msg('가까이에 대상이 없어요');const o=best.o;
if(best.t=='tree'){sfx('chop');o.hp--;o.m.rotation.z=.1;setTimeout(()=>o.m.rotation.z=0,100);if(o.hp<=0){sc.remove(o.m);trees=trees.filter(x=>x!=o);drop('wood',o.m.position,3);msg('목재가 떨어졌다! F로 줍기')}}
else if(best.t=='rock'){if(!inv.wpick&&!inv.ipick)return msg('곡괭이가 필요해요! (I → 제작)');sfx('mine');o.hp-=inv.ipick?2:1;if(o.hp<=0){sc.remove(o.m);rocks=rocks.filter(x=>x!=o);drop('stone',o.m.position,2);const rr=o.rich?2:1;if(Math.random()<.2*rr){drop('iron',o.m.position,1);msg('⛏️ 철광석 발견!')}if(Math.random()<.07*rr){drop('goldore',o.m.position,1);msg('✨ 금광석!')}if(Math.random()<.03*rr){drop('diamond',o.m.position,1);msg('💎 다이아몬드!')}}}
else{o.hp-=dmg();sfx('hit');if(o.hp<=0)kill(o);else if(o.boss)bossCheck(o);else if(!o.pa)o.m.position.add(new T.Vector3(o.m.position.x-P.x,0,o.m.position.z-P.z).normalize().multiplyScalar(1.2))}}
function kill(o){sc.remove(o.m);wolves=wolves.filter(x=>x!=o);const xp=XP[o.n]||10,g=Math.round(xp/2+rnd(0,5));P.g+=g;gainXp(xp);msg(o.n+' 처치! +'+xp+'XP +'+g+'G');qadd('kill',1);if(Math.random()<.25)drop('potion',o.m.position,1);if(o.n=='눈토끼')drop('meat',o.m.position,1);
if(o.boss){bossDead|=1<<dk;qadd(dk?'boss'+dk:'boss',1);drop('gem',o.m.position,5);if(dk==0)inv.dsword=(inv.dsword||0)+1;if(dk==1)inv.diamond=(inv.diamond||0)+6;if(dk==2)inv.fsword=(inv.fsword||0)+1;if(!eq.w&&dk!=1)equip(dk?'fsword':'dsword');msg('🏆 보스 처치! 보상을 얻었다!');sfx('ok')}invUI()}
function skill(k){if(P.sk>0)return;if(k=='z'){if(P.mp<8)return msg('MP가 부족해요');P.mp-=8;P.sk=3;P.sw=.4;sfx('hit');let n=0;wolves.slice().forEach(o=>{if(Math.hypot(o.m.position.x-P.x,o.m.position.z-P.z)<4.5){o.hp-=dmg()*2;n++;if(o.hp<=0)kill(o);else if(o.boss)bossCheck(o)}});msg('회전 베기! '+n+'마리 명중')}else{if(P.mp<10)return msg('MP가 부족해요');P.mp-=10;P.sk=4;P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+12);sfx('ok');msg('치유의 빛! HP +12')}}
function usePot(){if(inv.potion>0){inv.potion--;P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+15);msg('물약 사용! HP +15')}else if(inv.bread>0){inv.bread--;P.hp=Math.min(P.mx,P.hp+8);msg('빵을 먹었다! HP +8')}else return msg('물약이나 빵이 없어요');sfx('ok');invUI()}
function usePoison(){if(!(inv.poison>0))return msg('독포션이 없어요');inv.poison--;P.pz=10;sfx('ok');msg('무기에 독을 발랐다! (10회 공격)')}
/* 장비 / 인벤토리 / 제작 */
function equip(k){const s=EQ[k];if(!s||!(inv[k]>0))return;if(eq[s])inv[eq[s]]=(inv[eq[s]]||0)+1;inv[k]--;eq[s]=k;sfx('pick');msg(N[k]+' 장착');invUI()}
function unequip(s){if(!eq[s])return;inv[eq[s]]=(inv[eq[s]]||0)+1;eq[s]=null;invUI()}
function invUI(){const e=$('#inv');if(!e)return;const ks=Object.keys(inv).filter(k=>inv[k]>0),B=(t,f,k)=>'<button class=b data-k='+k+' onclick='+f+'(this.dataset.k)>'+t+'</button>';
e.innerHTML='<b>🎒 인벤토리</b> 💰'+P.g+'<br>⚔️ '+(eq.w?N[eq.w]+B('해제','unequip','w'):'맨손')+'<br>🛡️ '+(eq.a?N[eq.a]+B('해제','unequip','a'):'없음')+'<hr>'+(ks.length?ks.map(k=>'<div>'+N[k]+' ×'+inv[k]+(EQ[k]?B('장착','equip',k):'')+'</div>').join(''):'비어 있음')+'<hr><b>🔨 기본 제작</b><br>'+Object.keys(RC).map(k=>B(N[k]+' ('+Object.keys(RC[k]).map(r=>N[r]+RC[k][r]).join(',')+')','craft',k)).join('')+'<div style=font-size:12px>활·총·단검·고급 갑옷은 제작대(4번 블록, 목재4)에서!</div>'}
function craft(k){const r=RC[k];if(!Object.keys(r).every(x=>(inv[x]||0)>=r[x]))return msg('재료가 부족해요');Object.keys(r).forEach(x=>inv[x]-=r[x]);inv[k]=(inv[k]||0)+1;msg(N[k]+' 제작 완료!');sfx('ok');qadd(/pick/.test(k)?'pick':(EQ[k]=='w'?'sword':'x'),1);if(EQ[k]&&!eq[EQ[k]])equip(k);invUI()}
function craftUI(){const d=$('#dlg');d.style.display='block';d.innerHTML='<b>🔨 제작대</b><br>'+Object.keys(RC2).map(k=>{const r=RC2[k];return '<button class=b data-k='+k+' onclick=craft2(this.dataset.k)>'+N[k]+(r.n>1?'×'+r.n:'')+' ('+Object.keys(r.c).map(x=>N[x]+r.c[x]).join(',')+')</button>'}).join('')+'<br><button class=b onclick=closeDlg()>닫기</button>'}
function craft2(k){const r=RC2[k];if(!Object.keys(r.c).every(x=>(inv[x]||0)>=r.c[x]))return msg('재료가 부족해요');Object.keys(r.c).forEach(x=>inv[x]-=r.c[x]);inv[k]=(inv[k]||0)+r.n;sfx('ok');msg(N[k]+' 제작!');if(EQ[k]&&!eq[EQ[k]])equip(k);if(EQ[k]=='w')qadd('sword',1);invUI()}
function place(t,x,z,k){const f=t=='f',m=bx(sc,f?.6:1.2,f?.5:1.2,f?.6:1.2,{w:'#b5793a',s:'#9aa0a8',f:'#ff7a1a',t:'#6d4c2a'}[t],x,k*1.2+(f?.25:.6),z);if(t=='t')bx(m,1.3,.12,1.3,'#caa56a',0,.62,0);blocks.push({t,x,z,k,y:k*1.2+.6,m})}
/* 짐승 */
function beast(n){const b=BT[n],g=new T.Group(),c=b.c;if(n=='눈토끼'){bx(g,.4,.35,.6,'#fff',0,.3,0);bx(g,.3,.28,.3,'#fff',0,.45,.38);[-.08,.08].forEach(x=>{bx(g,.07,.3,.07,'#fff',x,.75,.35);bx(g,.06,.06,.04,'#d33',x,.5,.54)});return g}
bx(g,.7,.7,1.4,c,0,.7,0);bx(g,.5,.5,.5,c,0,.95,.85);bx(g,.3,.2,.2,c=='#f2f6fa'?'#ccd':'#333',0,.85,1.12);[-.12,.12].forEach(x=>{bx(g,.1,.1,.05,'#f00',x,1.05,1.12);bx(g,.12,.12,.08,c,x*1.6,1.25,.75)});
[[-.25,-.5],[.25,-.5],[-.25,.5],[.25,.5]].forEach(p=>bx(g,.15,.45,.15,'#222',p[0],.22,p[1]));bx(g,.12,.12,.7,c,0,.85,-.95);
if(n=='호랑이')[-.4,-.1,.2,.5].forEach(z=>bx(g,.74,.16,.1,'#222',0,.8,z));if(n=='사자')bx(g,.8,.8,.5,'#7a4a1a',0,.95,.6);if(n=='하이에나')[-.3,.1,.4].forEach(z=>bx(g,.72,.1,.12,'#5a4a2a',0,.9,z));if(n=='불꽃 임프')bx(g,.2,.5,.2,'#ff9a1a',0,1.5,.8);
g.scale.setScalar(b.s);return g}
function spawnB(n,x,z,o){const b=BT[n],m=beast(n);m.position.set(x,0,z);sc.add(m);const w={m,hp:b.hp,mhp:b.hp,a:rnd(0,6.28),n,s:b.s,dmg:b.dmg,sp:b.sp};Object.assign(w,o);wolves.push(w);return w}
function spawnW(){nn++;const k=Math.min(nn,6),L=[],add=(n,c)=>{for(let i=0;i<c;i++)L.push(n)};add('늑대',2+k);add('하이에나',1+(k>>1));add('멧돼지',1+(k>>1));if(k>=2)add('호랑이',k>>1);if(k>=3)add('사자',(k-1)>>1);if(k>=4)add('곰',1);L.forEach(n=>{const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(40,105);spawnB(n,Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r)})}
function clearW(){wolves.filter(w=>!w.d&&!w.st).forEach(w=>sc.remove(w.m));wolves=wolves.filter(w=>w.d||w.st)}
function mob(n,x,z){const B={'석상 왕':[160,8,2.8,2.2],'얼음 거인':[220,10,2.6,2.2],'화염 드래곤':[320,13,3.2,2.8]},bb=B[n];let m,hp=14,dm=3,sp=3.6,s=1;
if(bb){[hp,dm,sp,s]=bb;m=new T.Group();
if(n=='석상 왕'){bx(m,1.6,2,1,'#7f8c8d',0,2,0);bx(m,.9,.9,.9,'#95a5a6',0,3.5,0);[-.25,.25].forEach(a=>bx(m,.2,.2,.1,'#ff3b30',a,3.6,.46));[-1.2,1.2].forEach(a=>bx(m,.6,1.8,.6,'#7f8c8d',a,2,0));[-.5,.5].forEach(a=>bx(m,.7,1.2,.7,'#6c7a7b',a,.6,0));bx(m,1.2,.3,1.2,'#f1c40f',0,4.1,0)}
else if(n=='얼음 거인'){bx(m,1.8,2.2,1.1,'#bfe3ff',0,2.2,0);bx(m,1,1,1,'#dff1ff',0,3.9,0);[-.3,.3].forEach(a=>bx(m,.2,.2,.1,'#09f',a,4,.52));[-1.3,1.3].forEach(a=>bx(m,.7,2,.7,'#bfe3ff',a,2.2,0));[-.5,.5].forEach(a=>bx(m,.8,1.4,.8,'#9fd0f5',a,.7,0));[-.4,.4].forEach(a=>bx(m,.3,.8,.3,'#fff',a,4.7,0))}
else{bx(m,1.6,1.6,4,'#b02a1a',0,2,0);bx(m,1.1,1.1,1.4,'#c0392b',0,2.7,2.6);bx(m,.5,.4,.8,'#e74c3c',0,2.5,3.5);[-.35,.35].forEach(a=>{bx(m,.2,.2,.1,'#ffe600',a,3,3.3);bx(m,.25,.7,.25,'#ddd',a,3.6,2.4)});[-2.6,2.6].forEach(a=>bx(m,3.5,.15,2.2,'#7d1a10',a,3,0));bx(m,.8,.8,3,'#b02a1a',0,1.8,-3);[[-.6,-1.3],[.6,-1.3],[-.6,1.3],[.6,1.3]].forEach(p=>bx(m,.4,1.2,.4,'#7d1a10',p[0],.6,p[1]))}}
else if(BT[n]){m=beast(n);hp=BT[n].hp;dm=BT[n].dmg;sp=BT[n].sp;s=BT[n].s}
else{m=new T.Group();bx(m,.45,.45,.45,'#ecebe0',0,1.65,0);bx(m,.5,.7,.25,'#d8d6c8',0,1.1,0);[-.1,.1].forEach(a=>bx(m,.08,.08,.04,'#f33',a,1.68,.23));[-.32,.32].forEach(a=>bx(m,.12,.65,.12,'#ecebe0',a,1.1,0));[-.13,.13].forEach(a=>bx(m,.14,.75,.14,'#ecebe0',a,.38,0))}
m.position.set(x,0,z);sc.add(m);wolves.push({m,hp,mhp:hp,a:0,n,s,dmg:dm,sp,d:true,boss:!!bb})}
function bossU(dt){wolves.forEach(w=>{const d=Math.hypot(w.m.position.x-P.x,w.m.position.z-P.z);if(w.n=='화염 드래곤'){w.fb=(w.fb||2)-dt;if(w.fb<=0&&d<18&&d>4){w.fb=3.5;hurt(9,'🔥 화염 숨결!')}}if(w.n=='얼음 거인'){w.fb=(w.fb||3)-dt;if(w.fb<=0&&d<8){w.fb=5;hurt(7,'❄️ 얼음 충격파!')}}})}
function enterD(k){k=k||0;dk=k;DX=500+k*100;inD=true;P.x=DX;P.z=14;P.vy=0;P.y=0;const L=[['해골',8],['해골',10],['불꽃 임프',10]][k];for(let i=0;i<L[1];i++)mob(L[0],DX+rnd(-15,15),rnd(-15,5));if(!(bossDead&(1<<k)))mob(['석상 왕','얼음 거인','화염 드래곤'][k],DX,-12);msg(['🕳️ 석상 왕의 던전','❄️ 눈의 던전 - 얼음 거인이 기다린다','🌋 화염 던전 - 화염 드래곤이 깨어 있다'][k]);sfx('build')}
function leaveD(){inD=false;wolves.filter(w=>w.d).forEach(w=>sc.remove(w.m));wolves=wolves.filter(w=>!w.d);P.x=ENT[dk][0];P.z=ENT[dk][1]+8;P.y=0;msg('던전을 빠져나왔다.')}
/* 집 내부 */
function enterI(h){inI=h.t;lastH=h;P.x=900+h.t*30;P.z=3.5;P.vy=0;P.y=0;ILt.position.set(900+h.t*30,5,0);msg('🏠 '+TN[h.t])}
function leaveI(){inI=-1;P.x=lastH.ex;P.z=lastH.ez;P.y=0}
function sleep(){S.t=(Math.floor(S.t/180)+1)*180;P.hp=P.mx;P.mp=P.mmx;msg('😴 푹 잤어요. 아침이 밝았어요!');sfx('ok')}
function interior(i){const X=900+i*30,ty=['bed','chest','shop','smith','inn','lib'][i],sh=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(14,7,14),new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:'#d8b27a',side:T.BackSide}));sh.position.set(X,3.5,0);sc.add(sh);bx(sc,14,.4,14,'#8b5a2b',X,-.2,0);bx(sc,1.8,.06,.9,'#5a3a1a',X,.04,6);
const bed=(x,z)=>{const g=new T.Group();bx(g,2,.5,3,'#7a4a24',0,.25,0);bx(g,1.8,.25,2.8,'#f2f2f2',0,.62,0);bx(g,1.8,.3,.8,'#c0392b',0,.8,.9);bx(g,.8,.2,.5,'#fff',0,.85,-1);g.position.set(X+x,0,z);sc.add(g);npcs.push({m:g,n:'침대',k:'bed',st:1})};
const shelf=(x,z,c)=>{bx(sc,2.4,2.6,.7,'#6b4423',X+x,1.3,z);[0,1,2].forEach(j=>[-.8,0,.8].forEach(q=>bx(sc,.5,.4,.4,c[(j+q*2+9)%c.length|0],X+x+q,.6+j*.8,z+.4)))};
const COL=['#c0392b','#2980b9','#27ae60','#f1c40f','#8e44ad'];
if(ty=='bed'){bed(-4.5,-4.5);bx(sc,2,.9,1.2,'#8b5a2b',X+4,.45,-4)}
if(ty=='chest'){const g=new T.Group();bx(g,1.8,1,1.1,'#8b5a2b',0,.5,0);bx(g,1.8,.3,1.1,'#a0652a',0,1.15,0);bx(g,.3,.35,.1,'#f1c40f',0,.9,.58);g.position.set(X,0,-4.5);sc.add(g);npcs.push({m:g,n:'보관함',k:'chest',st:1});[-4,4].forEach(x=>{bx(sc,1.2,1,1,'#7a4a24',X+x,.5,-5.5)})}
if(ty=='shop'){bx(sc,6,1,1.2,'#8b5a2b',X,.5,-2.3);[-4.5,0,4.5].forEach(x=>shelf(x,-6.4,COL));addNPC('상인 모모','shop',X,-4,{g:'M',hair:0,img:IMG.shop,st:1})}
if(ty=='smith'){bx(sc,1.6,1,.9,'#555',X+3,.5,-3);bx(sc,2.5,1.6,1.6,'#7a3a1a',X-4,.8,-5.5);bx(sc,1.8,.5,1,'#ff7a1a',X-4,1.5,-5.3);addNPC('대장장이 철수','smith',X,-4,{g:'M',hair:1,img:IMG.smith,st:1})}
if(ty=='inn'){bed(-4.5,-4.5);bed(4.5,-4.5);bx(sc,2.4,.9,1.2,'#8b5a2b',X-4.5,.45,1);addNPC('여관 주인 미아','inn',X,-3,{g:'F',hair:1,img:IMG.inn,st:1})}
if(ty=='lib'){[-4.5,0,4.5].forEach(x=>shelf(x,-6.4,COL));addNPC('학자 에밀리','lib',X,-4,{g:'F',hair:4,img:IMG.lib,st:1})}}
function addNPC(n,k,x,z,o){o=o||{};const lk={g:o.g||(Math.random()<.5?'M':'F'),hair:o.hair!=null?o.hair:Math.floor(rnd(0,6)),eye:Math.floor(rnd(0,6)),top:Math.floor(rnd(0,6)),bottom:Math.floor(rnd(0,6)),hat:o.hat||0,shoe:Math.floor(rnd(0,6))},m=human(lk);m.position.set(x,0,z);if(!o.nl){const lb=label(n,k=='v'?'#fff':'#ffe08a');lb.position.y=2.9;m.add(lb)}sc.add(m);const e={m,n,k,l:o.l,img:o.img,t:0,a:0,mv:false,st:o.st};npcs.push(e);return e}
function addVill(){const i=npcs.filter(n=>n.k=='v').length;addNPC(VN[i%8],'v',rnd(-14,14),rnd(-14,14),{img:i%2?IMG.farm2:IMG.farm1,l:VL[i%5]})}
function addHouse(i){const a=i<6?i*1.047:(i-6)*.785+.39,r=i<6?12:20,g=new T.Group();bx(g,4,3,4,['#d9a066','#c98f5a','#e0b07a','#b97d4a'][i%4],0,1.5,0);bx(g,.9,1.8,.1,'#5a3a1a',0,.9,2.02);bx(g,1,1,.1,'#9ad1ff',1.2,1.8,2.02);const rf=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(3.6,2,4),M(['#a0392b','#2c6fb0','#7d5ba6'][i%3]));rf.position.y=4;rf.rotation.y=.785;rf.castShadow=true;g.add(rf);if(i<6){const lb=label(TN[i],'#ffe08a');lb.position.y=6.2;g.add(lb)}g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,Math.sin(a)*r);g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(-Math.cos(a),-Math.sin(a));sc.add(g);HS.push({t:i<6?i:0,dx:Math.cos(a)*(r-2.5),dz:Math.sin(a)*(r-2.5),ex:Math.cos(a)*(r-5),ez:Math.sin(a)*(r-5)})}
function buildVillage(){HS=[];for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addHouse(i);const f=new T.Group();bx(f,4,.6,4,'#8d949c',0,.3,0);bx(f,3,.5,3,'#3fa7ff',0,.55,0);bx(f,.5,1.8,.5,'#aab',0,1.2,0);sc.add(f);for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i*.785+.2,g=new T.Group();bx(g,.2,3,.2,'#3a3a3a',0,1.5,0);bx(g,.5,.5,.5,'#ffe08a',0,3.1,0);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*7,0,Math.sin(a)*7);sc.add(g)}
addNPC('촌장 하늘','chief',4,-5,{g:'M',hair:5,img:IMG.chief});addNPC('약초사 로즈','herb',-6,6,{g:'F',hair:5,img:IMG.herb});addNPC('빵집 아저씨','baker',8,6,{g:'M',hair:0,img:IMG.baker});addNPC('음유시인 리라','bard',-8,-6,{g:'F',hair:1,img:IMG.bard});addNPC('경비병 강','guard',0,19,{g:'M',hair:1});addVill();addVill()}
/* 지형 */
function mount(x,z,R,H,c){const m=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(R,H,7),M(c));m.position.set(x,H/2,z);m.castShadow=m.receiveShadow=true;sc.add(m);const cp2=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(R*.32,H*.3,7),M('#fff'));cp2.position.set(x,H*.85,z);sc.add(cp2);mt.push({x,z,r:R})}
function city(){const cx=185,g=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(80,80,.12,48),M('#4d5057'));g.position.set(cx,.07,0);g.receiveShadow=true;sc.add(g);
const wt=document.createElement('canvas');wt.width=64;wt.height=64;const c=wt.getContext('2d');c.fillStyle='#fff';c.fillRect(0,0,64,64);for(let y=0;y<8;y++)for(let x=0;x<8;x++){c.fillStyle=Math.random()<.35?'#ffe9a8':'#6d8fb3';c.fillRect(x*8+1,y*8+2,5,4)}
const tex=new T.CanvasTexture(wt);tex.wrapS=tex.wrapT=T.RepeatWrapping;
for(let gx=-4;gx<=4;gx++)for(let gz=-4;gz<=4;gz++){const q=Math.hypot(gx,gz);if(q>4.3||q<1.2)continue;const x=cx+gx*17,z=gz*17,w=rnd(8,12),h=rnd(30,130)*(1.1-q/8),t=tex.clone();t.needsUpdate=true;t.repeat.set(Math.max(1,Math.round(w/3)),Math.max(1,Math.round(h/3)));
const m=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,w),new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:['#8fa3b8','#a7b4c2','#7d8fa3','#b9a38a','#6f7f94'][(gx+gz+9)%5],map:t}));m.position.set(x,h/2,z);m.castShadow=m.receiveShadow=true;sc.add(m);mt.push({x,z,r:(w/2+.8)/.6})}
bx(sc,6,.6,6,'#9aa5b1',cx,.3,0);bx(sc,1.2,6,1.2,'#bcc6d0',cx,3.3,0);bx(sc,2.4,1,2.4,'#f1c40f',cx,6.5,0);
[[-14,10],[14,10],[-14,-10],[14,-10],[0,16],[0,-16]].forEach((p,i)=>{bx(sc,5,.3,3,['#c0392b','#2980b9','#27ae60','#f39c12'][i%4],cx+p[0],3,p[1]);bx(sc,.2,3,.2,'#555',cx+p[0]-2.3,1.5,p[1]-1.3);bx(sc,.2,3,.2,'#555',cx+p[0]+2.3,1.5,p[1]-1.3);addNPC(['잡화상 토니','약초상 주디','무기상 막스','방어구상 린','도시 상인 케이','보석상 아리'][i],'shop',cx+p[0],p[1]+1,{img:IMG.shop})});
addNPC('시장 에밀리','mayor',cx,6,{g:'F',hair:4,img:IMG.lib});
for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const ax=Math.random()<.5?1:0,pos=(Math.floor(rnd(-4,4))+.5)*17,e=addNPC(VN[i%8],'v',ax?cx+pos:cx+rnd(-65,65),ax?rnd(-65,65):pos,{img:[IMG.farm1,IMG.farm2,IMG.bard,IMG.baker][i%4],nl:true,l:VL[i%5]});e.cc=1;e.ax=ax;e.dir=Math.random()<.5?1:-1}}
function bigWorld(){mt=[];lavas=[];const disc=(x,z,r,c)=>{const m=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(r,r,.12,48),M(c));m.position.set(x,.07,z);m.receiveShadow=true;sc.add(m)};
disc(0,-185,76,'#f2f7ff');disc(-185,0,80,'#352622');city();
[[-120,-120,26,40,'#7d8590'],[120,-125,28,46,'#6f7882'],[-125,125,30,50,'#7a8a6e'],[125,125,26,42,'#7d8590'],[0,170,34,60,'#6f7882'],[-60,150,22,34,'#7a8a6e'],[75,160,24,38,'#7d8590'],[-110,-70,18,28,'#6f7882'],[110,-70,18,30,'#7d8590'],[-110,70,20,32,'#7a8a6e']].forEach(a=>mount(a[0],a[1],a[2],a[3],a[4]));
const vg=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(6,30,46,10),M('#4a2e26'));vg.position.set(-195,23,-14);vg.castShadow=true;sc.add(vg);const lv=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(5.5,5.5,.6,16),M('#ff5a14'));lv.position.set(-195,46.2,-14);sc.add(lv);const VL2=new T.PointLight(0xff5a14,1.4,90);VL2.position.set(-195,52,-14);sc.add(VL2);mt.push({x:-195,z:-14,r:30});
[[-160,40,8],[-215,38,9],[-150,-40,10],[-225,-42,8],[-175,58,7],[-140,10,8]].forEach(a=>{const l=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(a[2],a[2],.12,20),M('#ff5a14'));l.position.set(a[0],.14,a[1]);sc.add(l);lavas.push({x:a[0],z:a[1],r:a[2]})});
for(let i=0;i<55;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(10,70),g=new T.Group();bx(g,.5,1.6,.5,'#6b4a2f',0,.8,0);const c1=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(1.6,2.6,7),M('#dff0ff')),c2=new T.Mesh(new T.ConeGeometry(1.1,2,7),M('#eef7ff'));c1.position.y=2.6;c2.position.y=4;c1.castShadow=c2.castShadow=true;g.add(c1,c2);g.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,0,-185+Math.sin(a)*r);sc.add(g);trees.push({m:g,hp:3})}
for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(10,70),m=new T.Mesh(new T.DodecahedronGeometry(1.1),M('#bcd9ef'));m.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,.7,-185+Math.sin(a)*r);m.castShadow=true;sc.add(m);rocks.push({m,hp:5})}
for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(15,70),m=new T.Mesh(new T.DodecahedronGeometry(1.1),M('#3d3d44'));m.position.set(-185+Math.cos(a)*r,.7,Math.sin(a)*r);if(lavas.some(l=>Math.hypot(m.position.x-l.x,m.position.z-l.z)<l.r+2)||Math.hypot(m.position.x+195,m.position.z+14)<32){i--;continue}m.castShadow=true;sc.add(m);rocks.push({m,hp:5,rich:true})}
for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(10,60);spawnB('북극곰',Math.cos(a)*r,-185+Math.sin(a)*r,{st:true})}
for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(5,65);spawnB('눈토끼',Math.cos(a)*r,-185+Math.sin(a)*r,{st:true,pa:true})}
for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(20,65),x=-185+Math.cos(a)*r,z=Math.sin(a)*r;if(Math.hypot(x+195,z+14)<34||lavas.some(l=>Math.hypot(x-l.x,z-l.z)<l.r+1)){i--;continue}spawnB('불꽃 임프',x,z,{st:true})}}
function gate(x,z,col,t){const e=new T.Group();bx(e,1.4,6,1.4,'#666',-3,3,0);bx(e,1.4,6,1.4,'#666',3,3,0);bx(e,8,1.4,1.6,'#555',0,6.5,0);const p=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(2.4,2.4,.2,24),M(col));p.position.y=.1;e.add(p);const lb=label(t,'#fff');lb.position.y=8.5;e.add(lb);e.position.set(x,0,z);sc.add(e)}
function dungeon(){const th=[['#2f3238','#4b4f58',0xff9a3c],['#cfe8ff','#8fbce6',0x66ccff],['#3a1a14','#5a2a1a',0xff3300]];
for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const X=500+k*100,t=th[k];bx(sc,40,.6,40,t[0],X,-.3,0);[-20,20].forEach(z=>bx(sc,40,8,1,t[1],X,4,z));[-20,20].forEach(x=>bx(sc,1,8,40,t[1],X+x,4,0));bx(sc,41,1,41,'#222',X,9,0);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=X+(i%2?1:-1)*10,z=(i<2?-1:1)*10;bx(sc,1.4,8,1.4,k==1?'#bfe3ff':'#5d626c',x,4,z);bx(sc,.4,.4,.4,'#ff8c1a',x,5,z)}const L=new T.PointLight(t[2],1.3,45);L.position.set(X,6,0);sc.add(L);const ex=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(1.6,1.6,.2,24),M('#8e44ff'));ex.position.set(X,.1,19);sc.add(ex)}
gate(0,-96,'#8e44ff','던전 입구');gate(0,-246,'#66ccff','눈의 던전');gate(-250,0,'#ff5a14','화염 던전');
ILt=new T.PointLight(0xffd9a0,1.2,26);ILt.position.set(900,5,0);sc.add(ILt);for(let i=0;i<6;i++)interior(i);bigWorld()}
/* NPC 업데이트 / 상호작용 */
function bioU(dt){if(inD||inI>=0)return;mt.forEach(m=>{const d=Math.hypot(P.x-m.x,P.z-m.z),R=m.r*.6;if(d<R&&d>0){P.x=m.x+(P.x-m.x)/d*R;P.z=m.z+(P.z-m.z)/d*R}});lavas.forEach(l=>{if(Math.hypot(P.x-l.x,P.z-l.z)<l.r&&P.y<.5){P.hp-=4*dt;if(Math.random()<.03)msg('🔥 용암이 뜨거워요!')}});const b=biome(P.x,P.z);if(b!=curB){curB=b;msg(BIN[b])}}
function npcU(dt){let near=null,bd=3.8;npcs.forEach(n=>{const p=n.m.position,d=Math.hypot(p.x-P.x,p.z-P.z);
if(n.k=='v'){if(n.cc){const k=n.ax?'z':'x',c0=n.ax?0:185;p[k]+=n.dir*1.4*dt;if(Math.abs(p[k]-c0)>70)n.dir*=-1;n.m.rotation.y=n.ax?(n.dir>0?0:3.14):(n.dir>0?1.57:-1.57);n.mv=true}
else{n.t-=dt;if(n.t<0){n.t=rnd(1,4);n.a=rnd(0,6.28);n.mv=Math.random()<.6}if(n.mv&&d>3){p.x+=Math.cos(n.a)*1.2*dt;p.z+=Math.sin(n.a)*1.2*dt;n.m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(Math.cos(n.a),Math.sin(n.a));if(Math.hypot(p.x,p.z)>21)n.a=Math.atan2(-p.z,-p.x)}else n.mv=false}
if(n.m.lL){const s=n.mv?Math.sin(S.t*6)*.6:0;n.m.lL.rotation.x=s;n.m.lR.rotation.x=-s}}
else if(!n.st&&d<8)n.m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(P.x-p.x,P.z-p.z);
if(d<bd){bd=d;near=n}});
blocks.forEach(o=>{if(o.t=='t'){const d=Math.hypot(o.x-P.x,o.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;near={n:'제작대',k:'table'}}}});
const tk=$('#tk');if(tk)tk.textContent=near?'E : '+near.n+(near.k=='table'?' 사용':near.k=='bed'||near.k=='chest'?' 사용':'와(과) 대화'):'';
if(dlgN&&dlgN.m){const q=dlgN.m.position;if(Math.hypot(q.x-P.x,q.z-P.z)>5.5)closeDlg()}
if(!inD&&inI<0){ENT.forEach(e=>{if(Math.hypot(P.x-e[0],P.z-e[1])<2.5)enterD(e[2])});HS.forEach(h=>{if(Math.hypot(P.x-h.dx,P.z-h.dz)<1.2)enterI(h)})}
else if(inD&&Math.hypot(P.x-DX,P.z-19)<2.2)leaveD();else if(inI>=0&&Math.hypot(P.x-(900+inI*30),P.z-6)<1.3)leaveI();
bossU(dt)}
/* 대화 */
function dlg(who,t,ch){const d=$('#dlg'),n=dlgN||{},me=who=='me',img=me?(look.g=='F'?IMG.f:IMG.m):n.img;d.style.display='block';d.innerHTML='<div class=dr'+(me?' style="flex-direction:row-reverse"':'')+'>'+(img?'<img src="'+img+'">':'')+'<div class=dt><b>'+(me?names.p:n.n)+'</b><br>'+t+'<div>'+ch.map((c,i)=>'<button class=b onclick=dch('+i+')>'+c[0]+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div></div>';DCH=ch}
function dch(i){DCH[i][1]()}
function seq(L,fin,i){i=i||0;if(i>=L.length)return fin();dlg(L[i][0],L[i][1],[['▶',()=>seq(L,fin,i+1)]])}
function talk(){let b=null,bd=3.8;npcs.forEach(n=>{const d=Math.hypot(n.m.position.x-P.x,n.m.position.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;b=n}});blocks.forEach(o=>{if(o.t=='t'){const d=Math.hypot(o.x-P.x,o.z-P.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;b={k:'table',n:'제작대',m:o.m}}}});if(!b)return;dlgN=b;talkTo(b)}
function dlgU(){if(dlgN)talkTo(dlgN)}
function story(){const A=['어서 와요, 낯선 여행자. 이 섬에는 밤마다 맹수가 내려와요. 제작대(4번 블록)를 세우고 무기를 만들어 마을을 지켜 주세요.','경험이 쌓였군요. 북쪽 해안 던전에는 석상 왕이 잠들어 있어요. 그가 깨어난 뒤로 하늘길이 흔들렸죠…','석상 왕이 쓰러졌군요! 이제 북쪽 끝 설원의 눈 던전에서 얼음 거인을 막아 주세요.','다음은 서쪽 화염 땅이에요. 화염 드래곤이 하늘길을 태우고 있어요.','마지막으로 동쪽 대도시의 시장님을 찾아가세요. 모든 진실을 알고 계세요.'];return qi<7?A[0]:qi<12?A[Math.min(qi-6,4)]:FIN}
function want(k){const p=PR[k];seq([['me','저는 '+p[0]+'을(를) 살래요.']],()=>dlg('npc','정말 살 거야? '+p[0]+'은(는) '+p[1]+'G야.',[['네, 살게요',()=>seq([['me','네, 살게요.']],()=>{if(P.g<p[1])return seq([['npc','어라, 골드가 부족하네… 다음에 다시 와!']],closeDlg);P.g-=p[1];inv[k]=(inv[k]||0)+1;sfx('pick');invUI();seq([['npc','고마워! 여기 '+p[0]+' 받아. 또 와~']],closeDlg)})],['아니요',()=>seq([['me','음… 역시 그만둘래요.'],['npc','그래, 마음 바뀌면 와.']],closeDlg)]]))}
function sellUI(){const ks=Object.keys(SELLP).filter(k=>inv[k]>0);dlg('npc',ks.length?'뭘 팔래?':'팔 물건이 없네.',ks.map(k=>[N[k]+' ×'+inv[k]+' (+'+inv[k]*SELLP[k]+'G)',()=>{P.g+=inv[k]*SELLP[k];inv[k]=0;sfx('ok');invUI();sellUI()}]).concat([['그만',closeDlg]]))}
function shopFlow(){dlg('npc','안녕! 우리 가게에 와볼래? 독포션, 치유포션 등등을 팔아.',[['안 산다',()=>seq([['me','괜찮아요. 다음에 올게요.'],['npc','그래, 또 와!']],closeDlg)],['독포션을 산다',()=>want('poison')],['치유포션을 산다',()=>want('potion')],['재료를 판다',sellUI]])}
function chestUI(){const d=$('#dlg');d.style.display='block';const a=Object.keys(inv).filter(k=>inv[k]>0),b=Object.keys(chest).filter(k=>chest[k]>0);d.innerHTML='<b>📦 보관함</b><br>가방 → 보관<br>'+(a.map(k=>'<button class=b data-k='+k+' onclick=cput(this.dataset.k)>'+N[k]+' ×'+inv[k]+'</button>').join('')||'비어 있음')+'<br>보관함 → 가방<br>'+(b.map(k=>'<button class=b data-k='+k+' onclick=cget(this.dataset.k)>'+N[k]+' ×'+chest[k]+'</button>').join('')||'비어 있음')+'<br><button class=b onclick=closeDlg()>닫기</button>'}
function cput(k){chest[k]=(chest[k]||0)+inv[k];inv[k]=0;chestUI();invUI()}
function cget(k){inv[k]=(inv[k]||0)+chest[k];chest[k]=0;chestUI();invUI()}
function talkTo(n){const k=n.k,X=['닫기',closeDlg];
if(k=='table')return craftUI();if(k=='chest')return chestUI();
if(k=='bed')return dlg('npc','잠자리에 들까요? (아침까지 자고 HP/MP가 회복돼요)',[['잔다',()=>{sleep();closeDlg()}],X]);
if(k=='shop')return shopFlow();
if(k=='smith')return dlg('npc','어서 와! 무기를 강화해 줄까? 현재 +'+P.wl+' (최대 +5)',(P.wl<5?[['강화: 철광석 '+(P.wl+1)*2+'개 + '+(P.wl+1)*60+'G',()=>{forge();dlgU()}]]:[]).concat([X]));
if(k=='inn')return dlg('npc','어서 오세요! 하룻밤 10G, 빵 한 개 10G예요.',[['쉬어간다 (10G)',()=>{if(P.g<10)return seq([['npc','골드가 부족하네요…']],closeDlg);P.g-=10;sleep();seq([['npc','푹 쉬셨나요? 좋은 아침이에요!']],closeDlg)}],['빵을 산다',()=>want('bread')],X]);
if(k=='herb')return dlg('npc','약초로 만든 치유포션이야. 25G란다. 눈의 땅에는 귀한 약초가 많대.',[['치유포션을 산다',()=>want('potion')],X]);
if(k=='baker')return dlg('npc','갓 구운 빵이야! 한 개 10G. 먹으면 힘이 나지.',[['빵을 산다',()=>want('bread')],X]);
if(k=='bard')return dlg('npc','♪ 카피바라는 섬의 수호신~ 노래를 들으면 마음이 편해지지.',[['노래를 듣는다 (MP 회복)',()=>{P.mp=P.mmx;sfx('ok');msg('MP가 가득 찼다!');closeDlg()}],X]);
if(k=='chief')return dlg('npc','마을 레벨 '+vl+'/8. '+story()+(Q[qi]?' (지금 할 일: '+Q[qi].x+')':''),[['마을 발전 기부 (100G)',donate],X]);
if(k=='lib')return dlg('npc',story()+' 설원은 북쪽, 화염 땅은 서쪽, 대도시는 동쪽이에요.',[X]);
if(k=='mayor'){const ok=qi>=11;if(qi==11)qadd('city',1);return dlg('npc',ok?FIN:'아직 때가 아니에요. 세 던전의 수호자를 쓰러뜨리고 다시 오세요.',[X])}
if(k=='guard')return dlg('npc','북쪽 해안의 보랏빛 문이 석상 왕의 던전이오. 밤엔 호랑이와 사자가 나오니 마을 밖은 조심하시오!',[X]);
dlg('npc',n.l||'안녕하세요!',[X])}
</script></body></html>
